basic_details.job_title: CUTN Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for Consultant & Technical Assistant Posts

qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Bachelor's Degree of Engineering in Mechanical Engineering, Diploma in Mechanical Engineering
qualification.details: Consultant (Civil): Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University with 20 years of Engineering experience or more and retired at the level of Executive Engineer/equivalent cadre [Pay Level 10 or 11 (VII CPC)] or above, retired from Central / State Govt. / PSU / Govt. autonomous bodies Technical Assistant (HVAC): Bachelor's Degree of Engineering in Mechanical Engineering in relevant field from a recognised Institute/University with one year relevant experience OR Diploma in Engineering in the Mechanical Engineering relevant field and three years experience in relevant field in Central PWD/State PWD or Similar Organised Services/Statutory or Autonomous Organisations/Central/State Universities/Autonomous Institutions or Private Organization

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for CUTN Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.cutn.ac.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: CUTN Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the CUTN Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download CUTN Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Consultant (Civil): Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University with 20 years of Engineering experience or more and retired at the level of Executive Engineer/equivalent cadre [Pay Level 10 or 11 (VII CPC)] or above, retired from Central / State Govt. / PSU / Govt. autonomous bodies Technical Assistant (HVAC): Bachelor's Degree of Engineering in Mechanical Engineering in relevant field from a recognised Institute/University with one year relevant experience OR Diploma in Engineering in the Mechanical Engineering relevant field and three years experience in relevant field in Central PWD/State PWD or Similar Organised Services/Statutory or Autonomous Organisations/Central/State Universities/Autonomous Institutions or Private Organization

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for CUTN Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.cutn.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Central University of Tamil Nadu (CUTN) for filling up temporary positions at their campus in Thiruvarur, Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in CUTN Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts include Consultant (Civil) and Technical Assistant (HVAC) under advertisement number CUTN/TE/04/2026, offering opportunities for qualified engineering professionals.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies released?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for this recruitment drive, with 1 post allocated for Consultant (Civil) and 1 post for Technical Assistant (HVAC).

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for CUTN Recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply through offline mode by downloading the application form from the official website and sending it to the designated postal address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled-out offline application form to the Central University of Tamil Nadu is 10-10-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Consultant (Civil)?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Consultant (Civil) position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 65,000 based on the institutional guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What are the educational qualifications required for Technical Assistant (HVAC)?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering with one year of experience, or a Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with three years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No application fee is required for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, or ST categories as the fee is listed as Nil in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for CUTN posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these contractual government positions typically involves a Written Test followed by a personal Interview conducted by the university committee.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification?
faq.answer: You can visit the official Central University of Tamil Nadu website at www.cutn.ac.in to download the notification PDF and application form.
